latest.title: Global Well-posedness and Asymptotic Analysis of a Damped Nonlinear Wave Equation with a Codimension-One Constraint
latest.abstract: We prove the global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions to a constrained version of the damped nonlinear wave equation $$ \vartheta_{tt}+γ\vartheta_t-Δ\vartheta+|\vartheta|^{p-2}\vartheta=0 $$ on a smooth bounded domain $\varOmega\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, where the evolution is projected onto the tangent space of the Hilbert manifold $$\mathcal{M} = \left\{ \vartheta\in L^2(\varOmega):\|\vartheta\|_{L^2(\varOmega)}=1 \right\}, $$ which is the unit sphere in $L^2(\varOmega)$. We assume that $$p\in[2,\infty)\ \text{ for }\ d=1,2, \ \text{ while }\ 2\leq p\leq \frac{2(d-1)}{d-2} \ \text{ for }\ d\geq3.$$ By employing the Faedo--Galerkin approximation method, together with suitable a priori estimates and compactness arguments, we establish the global well-posedness of the problem. In particular, we show that the Hilbert manifold $\mathcal{M}$ is invariant under the flow, and hence the $L^2$-constraint is preserved throughout the evolution. Using the \emph{Lusternik--Schnirelmann theory}, we show that the corresponding stationary problem possesses at least countably many stationary solutions. We further investigate the long-time behaviour of solutions and prove that, along a subsequence, every solution of the constrained problem converges to a stationary solution by invoking \emph{Webb's theorem} and \emph{Barbalat's lemma}. When the initial data are sufficiently close to the first eigenfunction of the associated stationary problem, we show that the unique strong solution converges in $H_0^1(\varOmega)$ to the unique positive ground-state solution.
latest.workSummary: 对带 $L^2$ 单位球约束的阻尼非线性波方程建立 Faedo--Galerkin 全局强适定性，证明约束流形不变；进一步得到轨道渐近预紧、子序列收敛到平稳解，以及靠近第一特征函数时收敛到唯一正基态。
techniques: Webb 半群与 Barbalat 引理
latest.breakthrough: 把动力学约束乘子纳入统一能量和紧性框架，既保持 $L^2$ 球面不变，又将耗散轨道的长时间行为连接到平稳问题的基态选择。
latest.limitations: 指数范围受 Sobolev 临界指数限制，基态附近的全局收敛需要初值足够接近第一特征函数；一般初值只保证子序列收敛。

steps.claim: Galerkin 近似系统存在唯一解，并精确保持有限维 $L^2$ 约束流形。
steps.route: 在 Dirichlet 特征函数有限维空间投影方程，把约束乘子写成速度和非线性项的内积；ODE 局部理论给出解，再对约束函数求导验证其恒等为零。
steps.evidence: 第 3 节 Galerkin system 与 Proof of Theorem 1.2（PDF 第 12--16 页）。

steps.claim: 近似解具有与截断维数无关的能量估计，并收敛到全局强解且满足唯一性。
steps.route: 将方程分别与速度和高阶算子配对，阻尼耗散控制时间积分；Sobolev 嵌入处理非线性，Banach--Alaoglu、Aubin--Lions 与 Strauss 紧性把 Galerkin 序列传到极限，再用差分能量估计闭合唯一性。
steps.evidence: 第 3 节公式 (3.1)--(3.26) 与 Theorem 1.2 proof（PDF 第 12--21 页）。

steps.claim: 每条轨道在相空间渐近预紧，速度趋于零，并沿时间子序列收敛到满足约束的平稳方程解。
steps.route: 由耗散恒等式得到 $artheta_t\in L^2$，再用 Webb 半群结果和紧嵌入建立轨道预紧；Barbalat 引理使耗散量趋零，Lions--Magenes 与弱/强收敛把极限代回方程识别为平稳解。
steps.evidence: 第 4.1 节 Theorem 4.3、Proposition 4.6、Lemmas 4.7--4.8 及 Proof of Theorem 1.3（PDF 第 21--30 页）。

steps.claim: 初值足够接近第一正特征函数时，解全局趋于唯一正基态。
steps.route: 用约束流形上的 Lusternik--Schnirelmann 理论建立平稳解族并以最大值原理识别正基态；构造其邻域的能量陷阱，证明解保持在邻域内，再结合任意子序列极限唯一性把子序列收敛升级为全时间收敛。
steps.evidence: 第 4.2--4.3 节 Theorem 4.11、Lemmas 4.12、4.14--4.15 与 Proof of Theorem 1.4（PDF 第 31--39 页）。
